subtitle: nEuroPolice bureau. Continental Bureau of Bounties & Voluntary Declarations
emptyFile: The file is empty. As far as the Bureau is concerned, you have never done a thing.
notEnoughMoney: Not enough money for that fine.
nothingAffordable: Not even the smallest fine is within reach.
declarationBlurb: Confess to something the Bureau has not caught yet: the charge is filed at half the usual fine. It still sits on your record and raises your bounty until settled or served.
custodyBlurb: Outstanding bounty: {bounty}. Both options below sign you out of this terminal: the holding cells and the courtroom are not on the network.
surrenderBlurb: A van collects you and you are booked into the cells. Time served grinds the bounty down on its own, and you walk out the moment it reaches zero. No hearing, no judge.
hearingBlurb: Your file goes before Eris, Goddess of Justice. An acquittal wipes the record clean. A conviction does not.
alreadyInCustody: You are already in custody. The Bureau appreciates the enthusiasm.
surrenderConfirmBody: You will be transported to the cells and held until your bounty of {bounty} is worked off.
bookingOffline: The booking desk is not responding on this terminal.
hearingConfirmBody: Your case ({bounty} outstanding) goes before Eris. Her verdict stands.
hearingConfirmClean: You have no charges outstanding. Eris will still see you, and she will have opinions about that.
courtOffline: No court is currently accepting filings on this terminal.

record.heading: Case File — {name}
record.blurb: Every charge the Bureau has on you, with its fine. Settling one strikes it from the record and takes the money at once.
